title: Rich-Text Rendering & Parity

font.origin_policy: bundled default or explicit project font asset; no silent substitution

P30-AC-01.evidence: line_height/letter_spacing/alignment/wrap/auto-fit/spans alter rendered output; NFC vs NFD Vietnamese produce byte-identical ROI PNGs; CJK surfaces TextOverlayError::MissingGlyphs

P30-AC-02.evidence: bundled/asset font resolution deterministic; missing asset and unparsable face fail explicitly; export fails instead of substituting

P30-AC-03.evidence: preview_rich_text_overlay and export materialization return identical ROI and PNG bytes; rich items never emit drawtext; legacy items keep drawtext

P30-AC-04.evidence: linear/radial gradients, ordered multi-stroke, multi-shadow with blur, background box and per-span fill render deterministically (byte-identical repeated renders)

P30-AC-05.evidence: straight-alpha compositing over white has no dark halo; scale/rotation placement stays inside canvas bounds; artifacts alpha-white/black/color.png

P30-AC-06.evidence: cache clear+rebuild deterministic; stroke-style changes invalidate prepared masks; export removes text_overlays and tc_auto directories; real FFmpeg export embeds text pixels

P30-AC-07.evidence: W1 buffer warm p95 14.87 ms <= 16 ms; W2 packet p95 22.60 ms <= 33.3 ms; canonical one-line IPC packet p95 8.85 ms. Oversized multi-line ROI packet p95 27.81 ms exceeds 16 ms because of PNG transport; preview caches overlays per project revision, not per frame, and this limitation is documented.

P30-AC-08.evidence: 362 Rust tests targeted sets + 44 frontend tests + typecheck + web build + native build + cargo fmt pass; legacy text/captions/commands regression suites pass. Native GUI observation and interactive runtime health remain deferred (no native surface in this session), consistent with the Phase 26 deferred qualification.

benchmarks.host: Windows development host (same session; Phase 28 reference host budgets)

w1.definition: 120+ grapheme source text, 118deg gradient, 2 strokes, 2 shadows, wrapped to 1600 px, 1920x1080

w2.definition: 4 titles + shared rich style, sequential consumer render

known_limitations: Glow is not part of the Phase 29 canonical domain; it is not rendered in Phase 30 (deferred to a domain extension in Phase 32).
Only the bundled Roboto-Bold face ships with the app. Other weights/faces require a project font asset; weight is reported as approximated, never silently substituted.
Center/Inside stroke alignment is painted as a half-width outside dilation with the fill covering the inner half (documented approximation; Outside is exact).
Animation evaluation, keyframed text transform and per-frame motion are Phase 31; Phase 30 renders the static resolved style at canonical time.
Preview overlays are cached per project revision, not per frame. A first render of an oversized multi-line ROI can exceed the 16 ms IPC budget because of PNG transport.
Native GUI qualification (interactive preview overlay, installed-app resource lookup) remains deferred under the Phase 26 consolidated qualification.

closed_findings: descent sign/bleed clipping of descenders, diacritics, strokes and shadows
mask-cache signature collision and per-call cache loss in production
preview revision cache poisoning/null caching/stale async responses
